messages.content: Write three paragraphs describing a coastal town waking up on an autumn morning. Vary the sentence rhythm.
A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. Then he buys twice as many as he has left. How many sheep now? Explain each step.
Write a Python function `merge_intervals(intervals)` that merges overlapping [start, end] intervals, with a docstring and three example calls.
Compute the definite integral of x^2 * ln(x) from 1 to e. Show the integration-by-parts steps.
Return a JSON object for a library book with fields: title, authors (array), year, isbn, available (bool), tags (array of 3). Output only valid JSON.
Output the integers from 1 to 60, one per line, nothing else.

Repeat the following line exactly, character for character, and output nothing else:
anchor basil cedar delta ember fjord garnet harbor indigo jasper kettle lantern meadow nickel orchard pepper quartz ribbon saddle timber
